concerns.analysis: On page 34, multiple project titles (e.g., 'When Minutes Mattered...') are formatted as clickable hyperlinks in the source PDF. In the output, these titles appear as plain text paragraphs without inline links. The links were instead appended as extraction artifacts at the bottom of the page (and some link text was truncated). As a result, the actual reading flow is missing its clickable hyperlinks.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: "When Minutes Mattered: Automated COVID-19 Reporting System Saved Hospitals' Time and Reduced Administrative Burden" (formatted as a clickable link)
concerns.output_quote: "type": "paragraph", "text": "When Minutes Mattered: Automated COVID-19 Reporting System Saved Hospitals' Time and Reduced Administrative Burden" (lacking any inline link wrap)

concerns.analysis: On page 9, the kicker 'FEATURE ARTICLE' is incorrectly assigned as an H2, while the main title immediately following it, 'Cybersecurity as a Combined Effort', is assigned as an H1. Placing a level 2 heading before a level 1 heading reverses the expected containment relationship and breaks the heading hierarchy.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: 'FEATURE ARTICLE' appearing above 'Cybersecurity as a Combined Effort'
concerns.output_quote: "type": "heading", "level": 2, "text": "FEATURE ARTICLE" followed by "type": "heading", "level": 1, "text": "Cybersecurity as a Combined Effort"
